text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black goes to the racecourse to observe her rivals in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the top of her list of rivals is Brusquement, who is under the Empress Air Groove's tutelage and has been dominating her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporters swarm Brusquement now that she has been identified as the favorite to win the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Kitasan Black looks on, she becomes painfully aware of the gap between them.
